get.description: Current source VERSION and legacy commit/date/branch/repository fields; unknown when artifact metadata is absent

Compare strict SemVer release assets, never branch commits. Stable default; prerelease only explicit and highest genuine prerelease. Keeps update_available/current_commit/current_date/latest_commit/latest_date/latest_message/latest_author/repository/branch fields, adds current_version/latest_version. Unknown commits are not synthesized from versions. Metadata/network/local VERSION errors return update_available=false plus error.

post.description: Authenticated, CSRF-protected asynchronous release submission. Bodyless/{} means stable; acceptance is a matching coordinator claim, not completion. Windows validates before simulation. Requires verified managed installation; no legacy Git fallback.

200.description: Existing status=updating (or simulated on Windows) and message fields; updating adds the matching claimed request_id. Acceptance is not completion; poll protected status for that same ID.

400.description: Malformed/non-JSON/oversized body, unknown fields or invalid channel; error string

409.description: Another submission/request/update is busy, or migrated password hash missing; existing error string

500.description: Unavailable/legacy installation, no matching acknowledgement within 30 seconds or recovery required; actionable error string

get.description: Preserves log:string from bounded safe root-authored CONFIG_DIR/.updater-log.txt. Adds update:null or validated protected {request_id,phase,message,outcome}; outcome is running|updated|no-update|failed|blocked. Initial status may have request_id:null. Only matching phase=committed is success; rolled-back is no-update for the fixed No newer compatible release message, otherwise failure. Recovery phases are blocked. Ignore other IDs; no logs written in releases.
Unauthenticated, session-free readiness; 200 contains only status=ready and source VERSION; 503 when recovery or active-version checks fail
Installed and cached APT candidate version (openhab or evcc)

post.description: Start package list refresh or upgrade one package (refresh, openhab, evcc)
